title: Australian Aboriginal oral tradition concerning NHI

tellings.quote: Australian Aboriginal culture works right and apparently there's like a very um succinct and transmissible oral tradition that is really old like you know what 30,000 years old or something like that and it has to do with you know nhi and things like that

plain: Australia's Aboriginal peoples are said to keep a very old oral tradition, perhaps 30,000 years old, that is short and easy to pass on and deals with non-human intelligence, beings that are neither human nor animal. Diana Pasulka, a professor who studies religion, passes this on from Indigenous friends she does not name. If true, people would have been describing contact with such beings for tens of thousands of years.
